text:
ashley (partnerships): Starting a thread for the cross-cloud marketplace onboarding checklist. Goal: get a minimum viable listing across AWS/GCP/Azure that supports private offers, trial entitlements, and basic billing telemetry. Need owners and immediate blockers.
ravi (cloud-engineering): For parity, we should standardize the fulfillment webhook shape across clouds. Proposal: POST /marketplace/notify with payload {offer_id, customer_id, entitlement_code, plan, start_ts, expires_ts}. I'll sketch an adapter for SNS, Pub/Sub, and Event Grid.
sofia (product): Product wants the entitlement_code to include plan-level metadata and a feature-bit mask so we can enable Dedicated vs Hosted. Example: redwood:ent:{offer}-{plan}-{bits}. Also recommend embedding region to simplify routing.
maria (legal): Legal needs to sign off on the opt-in language for telemetry (EU) and a short clause for private offers that clarifies who receives billing metadata. Also need to confirm whether Azure shares billing identifiers with the partner for private plans.
noah (solutions): From partners: resellers want a trial conversion webhook so we can hand off provisioning to SIs. Can we add an optional callback_url in our entitlement payload? That would let resellers receive a conversion event.
marketplace-bot: MarketplaceBot: created resource group redwood-marketplace-staging; pubsub/sns topics provisioned.
ravi (cloud-engineering): Quick terraform snippet for the GCP SaaS metadata we need to set up (will paste in PR): ```json
{
  "name": "redwood-saas-listing",
  "billingAccount": "billing-123",
  "procurementApi": true
}
```
sofia (product): Packaging decision: do we publish one catalog entry with plans (trial, standard, dedicated) or separate listings per plan? I vote single listing with plans since marketplaces support plan-level SKUs. Keeps marketing cleaner.
maria (legal): Single listing with multiple plans OK, but contracts must allow per-plan SLA differences. We'll draft a short addendum template for plan-level SLAs and data residency.
ashley (partnerships): Action owners: ravi -> fulfillment adapters + unified webhook schema; sofia -> plan mapping + entitlement spec; maria -> legal addendum + telemetry opt-in language; noah -> reseller callback UX + examples. Can owners ack? Weekly checkpoint Thursday 11:00am PT.
noah (solutions): ack. I'll prepare reseller examples and CLI flow for token creation.
ravi (cloud-engineering): ack. I'll open PR with SNS/Lambda, Pub/Sub consumer, and Event Grid subscription examples. Include tests for retry semantics.
sofia (product): ack. I'll publish the plan-to-SKU mapping doc and sample marketplace payloads.
maria (legal): ack. I will upload redline and highlight EU retention points.
marketplace-bot: MarketplaceBot: scheduled smoke test for private-offer-activation tomorrow 03:00 PT. Test results will post to #ci-results.
